component.name: RudyDesk
component.summary: Remote desktop access from any device

description.p: RudyDesk lets you see and control another computer over the internet: help a relative, reach your office machine from home, or support a client. The session is peer-to-peer and encrypted; our server only introduces the two sides to each other.

ul.li: Screen sharing and remote control, with multi-monitor switching
File transfer in both directions and a shared clipboard
Chat, voice and camera during the session
Remote terminal and printing to your own printer
Unattended access with a device password, and view-only mode
Wake-on-LAN: wake a sleeping computer through another device on its network
Invite by one-time link — the other side needs no account
Interface in English, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Arabic and Chinese

description.p: A free plan covers personal use. Paid plans add unattended access without confirmation, session recording and the remote terminal.

screenshot.caption: Switching between the monitors of the remote computer
Main screen: your number, devices and invite link

description.p: The Windows sign-in screen can now be shown and typed into during a session. Ctrl+Alt+Del added to the session menu. Fixed: on monitors with display scaling the pointer could not reach the right and bottom edges. Waking through an ESP32 bridge now finds a neighbour even with a VPN enabled.
